sentence: This project tests whether combining a tumor-specific vaccination with radiopharmaceutical therapy can help the immune system fight advanced prostate cancer.
This project follows older adults over time to find out which risk factors, including daily changes in mood and sleep, lead to suicide attempts.
This project builds a biopsy needle with built-in imaging that lets doctors see lung tissue in real time, and tests it in a clinical trial.
This project tries to find out which Plasmodium vivax strains from infected patients grow in culture, and how mesenchymal stem cells affect its development.
This project tests whether biofilm-coated black carbon materials can reduce airborne PCB emissions from contaminated sediments, from lab reactors up to a field demonstration.
This project builds a tool that uses AI on CT images and ECG data to help doctors decide who needs advanced cardiac imaging.
This project studies how non-sense mediated decay is turned up in clear cell kidney cancer and whether triggering it improves response to immune checkpoint inhibition.
This project tries to find out which cell-based human model systems best predict toxicity in people exposed to hazardous substances after a disaster.
This project studies how a signaling pathway and a protein called Gpnmb control remyelination by neural stem cells in demyelinating diseases.
This project builds a platform that measures proteins, transcripts and metabolites in the same single cells, and uses it on blood and pancreatic islet cells.
This project tests whether an endoscopic system that combines photoacoustic microscopy and ultrasound can show how well rectal cancer responds to treatment before surgery.
This project develops a method to measure the energy behind protein shape changes, and uses it to design artificial protein sensors.
This project uses sequencing of several tumor regions to predict outcomes in basal breast cancer and to model how the disease progresses.
This project works on repairing the defective gene in blood cells of patients with a rare inherited immune disease, both outside and inside the body.
This project studies how sex and race relate to microRNAs and proteins in tears, and how they connect to dry eye disease.
This project maps the nerve cell circuits that become active during frontal lobe seizures, with very fine detail in space and time.
This project uses natural language processing to describe how Veterans store firearms, then links it to death records to see which methods lower suicide risk.
This project studies how extracellular vesicles carry RNA between cells to control metabolism and metabolic diseases.
This project builds biodegradable nanoparticles that deliver therapeutic agents to help blood vessels form in peripheral arterial disease and can be tracked with imaging.
This project tries to find out how a long non-coding RNA controls a chromatin remodeler and how too much changes gene expression in neurodevelopment.
